properties.label: Route
properties.description: Directed origin–destination pair; aggregate key for network logistics.

properties.label: Hub airport
properties.description: Airport with high outbound connection volume (derived by analytics threshold).

properties.label: Time window
properties.description: Named local-time band for scheduling analytics (HHMM on airport clock).

properties.label: On-time flight
properties.description: FAA on-time: arrDelay <= 15 AND depDelay <= 15 AND not cancelled.

properties.label: Delayed flight
properties.description: arrDelay > 15 OR depDelay > 15 (FAA delay threshold, minutes).

properties.label: Delay breakdown
properties.description: Attributed delay minutes per DOT cause on a single flight.

properties.label: Service level KPI
properties.description: Derived aggregate metric over Flight populations (not a Hive column).

properties.label: On-Time Performance (OTP)
properties.description: Percentage of OnTimeFlight among completed Flight in a scope (carrier, route, airport, time window). FAA/DOT 15-minute rule: arrDelay and depDelay both <= 15, cancelled = 0.

properties.label: On-time performance KPI
properties.description: Ratio of OnTimeFlight to completed Flight in a scope (carrier, route, window). Same concept as OTP.

properties.label: Delay attribution share KPI
properties.description: Share of total delay minutes by DelayReason in a scope.

properties.label: primary delay reason
properties.description: Argmax of carrierDelay, weatherDelay, nasDelay, securityDelay, lateAircraftDelay (non-null).

properties.label: has on-time performance
properties.description: Aggregate OTP metric computed over a flight population at query time.

properties.label: measuresKPI
properties.description: Links aggregated KPI instances to contributing flights (materialized in analytics layer).

properties.label: isHub
properties.description: True when airport exceeds hub traffic threshold in a reference period.

properties.label: OTP percentage
properties.description: 100 * COUNT(OnTimeFlight) / COUNT(completed Flight); see airline_business_rules.yaml otp.sql.expr.

properties.label: on-time threshold (minutes)
properties.description: Maximum arrDelay and depDelay for OnTimeFlight (FAA default 15).

properties.label: scheduledInWindowClass
properties.description: TimeWindow class name from business rules (MorningPeak, EveningPeak, …).

properties.label: D0 departure OTP
properties.description: Share of completed flights with depDelay <= 15 min (FAA D0).

properties.label: A0 arrival OTP
properties.description: Share of completed flights with arrDelay <= 15 min (FAA A0).

properties.label: Zero-minute delay rate
properties.description: Flights with arrDelay=0 AND depDelay=0 among completed.

properties.label: Delayed flight rate
properties.description: DelayedFlight share (FAA >15 min on arr or dep).

properties.label: Average max delay
properties.description: Mean of GREATEST(arrDelay, depDelay) on completed flights.

properties.label: Total delay minutes
properties.description: Sum of GREATEST(arrDelay, depDelay) on completed delayed flights.

properties.label: Severe delay rate
properties.description: SevereDelay class share (>60 min max delay).

properties.label: Uncontrollable delay share
properties.description: Weather + NAS + security attributed minutes share.

properties.label: Attributed delay coverage rate
properties.description: Delayed flights with any DOT cause minutes > 0.

properties.label: Available seat miles (proxy)
properties.description: SUM(distance) on completed flights — seat-mile proxy without seats column.

properties.label: Block completion rate
properties.description: Flights where actualElapsedTime <= crsElapsedTime + 15 among completed.

metadata.numerator: SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) <= 15 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
metadata.denominator: NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
metadata.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) <= 15 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

D0DepartureOTP.definition: Percentage of completed flights with departure delay <= 15 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

A0ArrivalOTP.definition: Percentage of completed flights with arrival delay <= 15 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

CompletionRate.definition: Share of scheduled flights that were not cancelled.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND (diverted = '1' OR diverted = 'Y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

ZeroMinuteDelayRate.definition: Completed flights with exactly zero arrival and departure delay.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

DelayedFlightRate.definition: FAA delayed flight share (>15 min on arrival or departure).

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND (COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > 15 OR COALESCE(depdelay,0) > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

EarlyArrivalRate.definition: Completed flights arriving ahead of schedule (arrDelay < 0).

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

EarlyDepartureRate.definition: Completed flights departing ahead of schedule (depDelay < 0).

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

DepartureDelayDominantRate.definition: Among delayed flights, share where depDelay exceeds arrDelay.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) > 15 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) > COALESCE(arrdelay,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND (COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > 15 OR COALESCE(depdelay,0) > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(depdelay,0) END), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) END), 2)
SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) ELSE 0 END)
SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(arrdelay,0) ELSE 0 END)
SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(depdelay,0) ELSE 0 END)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) BETWEEN 16 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

ExtremeDelayRate.definition: Flights with max delay exceeding 180 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > 15 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > COALESCE(depdelay,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND (COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > 15 OR COALESCE(depdelay,0) > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(nasdelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(securitydelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)

ControllableDelayShare.definition: Carrier + late-aircraft attributed minutes as share of total attributed delay.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)

UncontrollableDelayShare.definition: Weather + NAS + security attributed minutes share.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)), 0), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(carrierdelay,0) END), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(weatherdelay,0) END), 2)

AttributedDelayCoverageRate.definition: Delayed flights with any DOT cause minutes recorded.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND (COALESCE(carrierdelay,0)+COALESCE(weatherdelay,0)+COALESCE(nasdelay,0)+COALESCE(securitydelay,0)+COALESCE(lateaircraftdelay,0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND (COALESCE(arrdelay,0) > 15 OR COALESCE(depdelay,0) > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(taxiout,0) END), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(taxiin,0) END), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(airtime,0) END), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(actualelapsedtime,0) END), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(actualelapsedtime,0) - COALESCE(crselapsedtime,0) END), 2)

LongTaxiOutRate.definition: Share of flights with taxiOut > 20 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(taxiout,0) > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

LongTaxiInRate.definition: Share of flights with taxiIn > 10 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(taxiin,0) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

ExtendedBlockTimeRate.definition: actualElapsedTime exceeds scheduled block by more than 15 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(actualelapsedtime,0) > COALESCE(crselapsedtime,0) + 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(actualelapsedtime,0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(taxiout,0) * 1.0 / actualelapsedtime END), 4)

BlockCompletionRate.definition: Flights completed within scheduled block + 15 minutes.

sql.expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(actualelapsedtime,0) <= COALESCE(crselapsedtime,0) + 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

AvailableSeatMiles.definition: SUM(distance) — ASM proxy without seats column in DOT data.

sql.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(distance,0) ELSE 0 END)
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN COALESCE(distance,0) END), 1)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(distance,0) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(distance,0) < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
COUNT(*)

ArrivalOperationCount.note: Use dest column when aggregating arrivals; same expr on arrival-filtered dataset.

sql.expr: COUNT(*)
COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(origin, '-', dest))
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND tailnum IS NOT NULL AND tailnum != '' THEN tailnum END)
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND tailnum IS NOT NULL AND tailnum != '' THEN tailnum END), 0), 2)

ROUND(
  0.5 * (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND COALESCE(arrdelay,0) <= 15 AND COALESCE(depdelay,0) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0))
+ 0.3 * (100.0 - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 AND GREATEST(COALESCE(arrdelay,0), COALESCE(depdelay,0)) > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) + 0.2 * (100.0 - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) , 2)

properties.scenario: Analysis of airline operational performance for the year 2003 using the knowledge graph and business rules. Selection of top 5 airlines by On-Time Performance (OTP) in 2003.
properties.reasoning: Based on business rule defining on-time as arrival delay ≤ 15 minutes (from /workflow_data/config/airline_business_rules.yaml), and SQL query executed on flights and airlines tables. Airlines are ranked by OTP percentage, ensuring transparency and reproducibility of the results.
properties.sql_text: SELECT a.description AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN f.arrdelay <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_flights, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.arrdelay <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS otp_percentage FROM airlinedata.flights f JOIN airlinedata.airlines a ON f.uniquecarrier = a.code WHERE f.year = 2003 GROUP BY a.description ORDER BY otp_percentage DESC LIMIT 5
properties.content: Analysis of airline operational performance for the year 2003 using the knowledge graph and business rules. Selection of top 5 airlines by On-Time Performance (OTP) in 2003.

properties.outcome: Top airports with most midday severe delays (2000–2005): ORD, DFW, ATL, PHX, LAX, DEN, SFO, DTW, EWR, LAS. See table for details.
properties.scenario: Identify airports with the most congestion and severe delays during midday (10:00–16:59) between 2000 and 2005. Severe delay defined as max(arrdelay, depdelay) > 60 minutes. Congestion measured by count of such severe delays per airport. SQL joined flights and airports on origin IATA, filtered for time window and years, ranked airports by severe delay count.
properties.reasoning: This decision documents the methodology and results for identifying airports with the highest midday congestion due to severe delays, supporting operational and strategic analysis. Business definitions for severe delay, midday window, and congestion metric are explicitly stated for auditability. The SQL query and ranked results are included for traceability and reproducibility.
properties.sql_text:
SELECT flights.origin AS airport_iata, airports.airport AS airport_name, COUNT(*) AS severe_delay_count
FROM airlinedata.flights
JOIN airlinedata.airports ON flights.origin = airports.iata
WHERE flights.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
  AND GREATEST(COALESCE(flights.arrdelay,0), COALESCE(flights.depdelay,0)) > 60
  AND flights.crsdeptime BETWEEN 1000 AND 1659
GROUP BY flights.origin, airports.airport
ORDER BY severe_delay_count DESC
properties.content: Identify airports with the most congestion and severe delays during midday (10:00–16:59) between 2000 and 2005. Severe delay defined as max(arrdelay, depdelay) > 60 minutes. Congestion measured by count of such severe delays per airport. SQL joined flights and airports on origin IATA, filtered for time window and years, ranked airports by severe delay count.

properties.outcome: The top airports by midday congestion (2000–2005) were: ORD (Chicago O'Hare), DFW (Dallas-Fort Worth), ATL (Atlanta), LAX (Los Angeles), PHX (Phoenix), IAH (Houston Intercontinental), DEN (Denver), MSP (Minneapolis-St Paul), LAS (Las Vegas), and DTW (Detroit). ORD had the highest operated flights (906,826) and delayed flights (247,438) during midday, indicating significant congestion. Both operated and delayed flights provide a comprehensive view of congestion challenges at these airports.
properties.scenario: Identify airports with the most congestion during midday (10:00–16:59) between 2000 and 2005, using both operated flights and delayed flights (arrival or departure delay > 15 minutes) as measures of congestion. Analysis covers all US airports in the airlinedata Hive database.
properties.reasoning: Congestion was measured by counting all non-cancelled flights (ontology class Flight) scheduled to depart during the Midday time window (crsdeptime 1000–1659) from 2000 to 2005, and by counting those flights with arrival or departure delay greater than 15 minutes (ontology class DelayedFlight). Airports with the highest operated and delayed flight counts were identified as the most congested. This approach aligns with business rules for delay and congestion classification.
properties.sql_text: SELECT airports.iata AS airport_code, airports.airport AS airport_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN flights.cancelled = 0 THEN 1 END) AS operated_flights, COUNT(CASE WHEN flights.cancelled = 0 AND (COALESCE(flights.arrdelay,0) > 15 OR COALESCE(flights.depdelay,0) > 15) THEN 1 END) AS delayed_flights FROM airlinedata.flights INNER JOIN airlinedata.airports ON flights.origin = airports.iata WHERE flights.crsdeptime BETWEEN 1000 AND 1659 AND flights.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY airports.iata, airports.airport ORDER BY operated_flights DESC
properties.content: Identify airports with the most congestion during midday (10:00–16:59) between 2000 and 2005, using both operated flights and delayed flights (arrival or departure delay > 15 minutes) as measures of congestion. Analysis covers all US airports in the airlinedata Hive database.

properties.scenario: Identify airlines with the most severe delays (arrival or departure delay > 60 minutes) during midday (10:00–16:59) on Sundays between 2000 and 2005.
properties.reasoning: Severe delays are defined per business rules as flights where either arrival or departure delay exceeds 60 minutes. The analysis considers only non-cancelled flights scheduled to depart during the midday window (crsdeptime 1000–1659) on Sundays (dayofweek=7) from 2000 to 2005. Results are grouped by airline (ontology class Airline), using the join flights.uniquecarrier = airlines.code. This approach aligns with the ontology's delay severity classification and ensures comparability across carriers and time periods.
properties.sql_text: SELECT airlines.code AS airline_code, airlines.description AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS severe_delay_flights FROM airlinedata.flights AS flights INNER JOIN airlinedata.airlines AS airlines ON flights.uniquecarrier = airlines.code WHERE GREATEST(COALESCE(flights.arrdelay,0), COALESCE(flights.depdelay,0)) > 60 AND flights.crsdeptime BETWEEN 1000 AND 1659 AND flights.dayofweek = 7 AND flights.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY airlines.code, airlines.description ORDER BY severe_delay_flights DESC
properties.content: Identify airlines with the most severe delays (arrival or departure delay > 60 minutes) during midday (10:00–16:59) on Sundays between 2000 and 2005.
